faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OAV Garudabasa Hostel Support Staff posts?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the Hostel Support Staff positions at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Garudabasa is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Hostel Support Staff?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for Hostel Support Staff positions at OAV Garudabasa. These include roles such as Warden, Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, Head Cook, and Assistant Cook.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the OAV Garudabasa Hostel Support Staff recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. For Warden, a B.A./B.Sc. with hostel management experience is required. For Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, an HSC examination is needed. Specific qualifications for Head Cook and Assistant Cook are not detailed here.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for OAV Garudabasa recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Hostel Support Staff positions?
faq.answer: The salary varies per post. The Warden post offers Rs 21,175/- per month, Head Cook Rs 9,000/-, Assistant Cook Rs 6,750/-, and Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper Rs 7,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Hostel Support Staff positions at OAV Garudabasa primarily involves Application Screening and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, which is https://oav.edu.in/OAVGOR. Please ensure you download the correct form from the official source.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Hostel Support Staff recruitment by Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Garudabasa is 01.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Garudabasa, situated in Betnoti, Odisha, with the pincode 757100.
